proposal.residence_time_basis: Nominal gas-liquid hydraulic residence time based on the 5.0 mL coil volume divided by total inlet channel volumetric flow at 21 C and 6 bar absolute: 5.0 mL/(0.100 mL/min liquid + 0.180 mL/min compressed air) = 17.9 min. This assumes ideal-gas behavior and negligible net gas absorption or reaction-driven gas-volume change.
proposal.light_setup: Place the entire 5 mL FEP photocoil in the compatible 420 nm LED irradiation zone. Use the listed 20 W, 420 nm LED at its specified nominal 100 mW/cm2 irradiance; maintain coil temperature at 21 C by monitoring during irradiation. Shield the LED/coil assembly from operator viewing.

streams.contents: Fmoc-L-methionine (1.0 equiv, 0.100 M) plus 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole photocatalyst (0.010 M, 10 mol%)

Air; inlet flow is 1.00 sccm at STP. At 5 bar gauge BPR pressure (assumed 6.0 bar absolute) and 21 C, the ideal-gas in-channel flow is 0.180 mL/min. The pressure-only correction, before the 21 C versus STP temperature correction, is 0.167 mL/min.

proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: Pump the homogeneous liquid reagent/catalyst solution to one T-mixer inlet and meter air to the other inlet. Send the T-mixer outlet directly into the illuminated 1.0 mm ID coil so that segmented gas-liquid flow is established before irradiation. Air is selected rather than oxygen to most closely reproduce the batch protocol's exposure to air while reducing oxygen-enrichment risk.
pre_reactor_steps: Prepare the liquid feed at the batch-validated composition: 0.100 M Fmoc-L-methionine and 0.010 M photocatalyst in acetonitrile. For the stated 3.7 mmol substrate scale, this corresponds to 37 mL of feed and 0.37 mmol photocatalyst.
Do not degas the feed; the batch procedure explicitly used air exposure.
Load the liquid feed into Syringe pump A and set 0.100 mL/min.
Set the air MFC to 1.00 sccm referenced to STP, within its 0.1-100 sccm operating range.
Install the 5 bar BPR downstream of the photocoil, pressure-test all gas-contacting FEP connections below the 20 bar component limit, then establish stable segmented flow before turning on the LED.
After stable flow is observed, turn on the 420 nm LED and begin collection only after at least two nominal in-channel residence times (about 36 min).
post_reactor_steps: Keep the BPR downstream of the irradiated coil throughout collection to maintain the specified back-pressure condition.
Collect depressurized effluent in a ventilated, light-protected vessel; do not add a quench or additional reagent because none is specified in the available inventory.

For the first screen, collect a steady-state fraction after the two-residence-time startup period and compare conversion/selectivity with the batch reference using an available validated offline analytical method.
At shutdown, turn off the LED, stop liquid flow, close the gas flow, and depressurize slowly in a ventilated enclosure.
proposal.chemistry_notes: The liquid feed exactly retains the batch substrate concentration and photocatalyst loading. At 0.100 mL/min of 0.100 M substrate, substrate delivery is 0.0100 mmol/min. Air at 1.00 sccm is approximately 0.0446 mmol/min total gas at STP, containing approximately 0.0094 mmol/min O2 (0.94 O2 equivalents per substrate molar-flow equivalent). This is nominally greater than the 0.5 O2 equivalent required for a one-oxygen-atom oxidation, but actual conversion remains dependent on gas-liquid transfer and the reaction mechanism. The 17.9 min nominal flow residence time is intentionally conservative relative to the 5 min batch irradiation because photon flux geometry and oxygen transfer are not directly transferable from batch.

parameters.collection_condition: stable pressure, stable segmented flow, LED on

reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.100 M reproduces the batch concentration exactly.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: 0.100 mL/min is within the 0.01-5.0 mL/min pump range and provides a low, conservative liquid throughput.
reasoning_per_field.gas_flow: 1.00 sccm air is above the MFC minimum, below its maximum, and provides a substantial segmented-flow gas fraction while retaining air rather than enriched oxygen.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: The 5 bar BPR is an available setting and is well below the 20 bar rating of the gas hardware, tubing, and pump.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: The 5 mL coil is selected over the 10 mL coil to minimize reactive holdup while still providing a conservative 17.9 min nominal gas-liquid residence time.
reasoning_per_field.residence_times: Liquid-only residence time is 50.0 min; the gas-liquid in-channel hydraulic residence time is 17.9 min after pressure/temperature correction of the gas flow.
reasoning_per_field.wavelength_nm: 420 nm is within the required 410-430 nm range and directly matches both the validated batch excitation center and available coil-compatible LED.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: 21 C reproduces the batch temperature and is far below the 80 C coil limit.

proposal.literature_analogies: The direct experimental analogue is the supplied batch protocol: 0.10 M substrate in acetonitrile, 10 mol% 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole, air exposure, 420 nm irradiation, and 21 C. No external flow-specific literature citation was supplied; therefore, gas-transfer and photon-delivery effects are treated as screen variables rather than assumed equivalent to batch.
safety_flags: Acetonitrile is flammable; operate away from ignition sources and contain the irradiated setup appropriately.
Air flow through a pressurized system can create an oxygen-containing vent stream; vent/depressurize in a ventilated enclosure and avoid ignition sources.
Use the 5 bar BPR downstream of the coil; inspect FEP tubing and fittings before operation and do not exceed the 20 bar hardware/tubing/pump ratings.
The 420 nm LED is a high-intensity optical source; use a light shield and appropriate eye/skin protection.
Monitor coil temperature during irradiation. Stop the run for leaks, loss of back-pressure, unstable gas-liquid flow, or unexpected temperature rise.
proposal.confidence: Moderate for hardware feasibility and arithmetic; low-to-moderate for reaction performance until gas-liquid mass transfer, illuminated residence time, and product selectivity are experimentally checked.

disposition_rationale: The design is physically compatible with the available 420 nm photocoil, LED, pump, gas-liquid T-mixer, and 5 bar BPR. It deliberately preserves the validated 0.10 M substrate concentration, 10 mol% photocatalyst loading, air atmosphere, and 420 nm excitation window. It remains a SCREEN rather than EXECUTE because gas-liquid mass transfer, irradiance distribution in the larger flow coil, gas holdup, and the effect of the longer nominal illuminated residence time require experimental verification.
